parsed.post: Clean control confirms the leak: depth6 on 0-9 scores 1.060 vs 0.913 on 0-10 — ~14% inflation from memorizing eval shard 10. Real depth6 gain is 1.096->1.060 on clean data. I'm advancing the clean branch; next: warmup 0.05. Requesting operator ruling on 0-10.
parsed.description: Stay on clean branch (depth6, shards 0-9, batch 262144) and add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize early LR on uncontaminated data.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so those runs train on the validation shard. My clean control (0-9, depth6) scored 1.060 vs 0.913 with 0-10 — most recent 'gains' on the board look like memorization, not generalization. Please rule on whether 0-10 results are admissible; until then I'm optimizing on 0-9.
